title: Senior Big Data Software Engineer (AWS + Databricks)

title: Analista de negocio (Business Analyst)
descriptionText: Buscamos un/a Analista de Negocio (Business Analyst) que trabaje en equipos pequeños resolviendo problemas complejos de negocio para clientes: estructurar el problema, analizar datos, generar insights y comunicar recomendaciones accionables. Requisitos • Título universitario en Ingeniería Civil Industrial, Comercial/Economía o carreras afín. • Excel avanzado y PowerPoint. • Manejo en herramientas de IA para acelerar investigaciones y presentaciones. Responsabilidades • Estructurar problemas de negocio y formular hipótesis. • Recopilar y analizar información cuantitativa y cualitativa (modelos en Excel, benchmarks, entrevistas, investigación de mercado). • Sintetizar hallazgos en presentaciones claras y orientadas a la acción. • Presentar avances y conclusiones a clientes y gerencia. • Apoyar la implementación de recomendaciones. Habilidades clave • Resolución de problemas: pensamiento estructurado e hipotético-deductivo. • Rigor analítico: comodidad con números y capacidad de sacar conclusiones de datos incompletos. • Comunicación: síntesis escrita y oral. • Liderazgo e iniciativa: ownership, proactividad, capacidad de impulsar el trabajo sin supervisión constante. • Impacto personal: trabajo en equipo, credibilidad frente a clientes y adaptabilidad en entornos exigentes. Ofrecemos: Trabajo de jornada completa, por 6 meses, modalidad híbrida (3 a 4 días presencial).

title: Regional Performance Management Sr. Analyst
descriptionText: Job Description Role Purpose The Regional Performance Management Analyst is a high-impact Business Partner responsible for delivering performance management analysis across Lines of Business and geographies , providing business partnering support and meeting key stakeholder needs. The role integrates Line-of-Business, Country , and specialist insights to deliver accurate Strategic Plan, Annual Plan, Forecast and Month-End Close outputs, while providing timely and actionable analysis that supports the business decision-making process. This role operates in an evolving environment where routine data gathering, reconciliations, recurring commentary, and standard report generation are increasingly automated, standardized, or agent-enabled. The Regional Performance Management Analyst needs to be able to effectively work in such a changing environment, with less focus on data procurement and consolidation and an increased focus on working in a digitally enabled performance management environment , delivering meaningful analysis, enriched with insight . The Regional Performance Management Analyst is expected to interpret key business drivers, evaluate scenarios, surface risks and opportunities, and guide decision-making. Success in the role depends on combining strong finance judgment with digital fluency, adaptability to evolving tools and processes, and a continuous improvement mindset. Key Responsibilities Critical Tasks The Regional Performance Management Analyst will support all FP&A cycles, including Strategic Plan, Annual Plan, Forecast and Month-End Close, as well as projects and ad hoc requests. Responsibilities include: Digital & Agent-Enabled Working Ecosystem & Stakeholder Interactions Lead a Performance Management cycle (Forecast or Month-End Close) end to end, including coordination of activities, variance analysis, and management reporting.
